original.title: The Spiral of Silence a Theory of Public Opinion

core_idea: People fear social isolation, so they watch the climate of opinion. Those who think their view is losing tend to stay silent, which makes the dominant view seem even stronger, and the spiral continues.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: Do people self-censor on controversial topics, online or offline?
How does perceived opinion climate affect willingness to speak out?
common_mistakes: Measuring only opinion, not willingness to speak out.
Ignoring the 'hard core' who speak regardless.
Assuming online settings work the same as face-to-face.
